recentItems.title: PM Modi's Historic Visit to Uzbekistan | Strengthening India-Uzbekistan ties and much more | #shorts
recentItems.description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a historic and successful visit to Uzbekistan as both countries decided to take the bilateral relations into a strategic comprehensive partnership. Watch highlights from the visit, which included a ceremonial welcome, guard of honour, and bilateral talks between PM Narendra Modi and President Shavkat Mirziyoyev.

recentItems.title: Students in Tashkent recite PM Modi's poem 'Abhi to Suraj Uga Hai'
recentItems.description:
PM Modi visited the Tashkent State University of Oriental Studies in Uzbekistan. Students recited verses and poems written by PM Modi which amazed the PM so much! PM also praised the students’ dedication towards bringing out the exact sense of the lines that PM wrote. The PM also shared insights on the cultural exchange between India and Uzbekistan.
